Q: How do you test a prompt without rewarding the exact wording of its expected answer?
spoken: Freeze a task contract and labeled cases describing acceptable facts, required behavior, abstention and forbidden actions. Check semantics and structured boundaries rather than exact prose unless exact serialization is the requirement. Include adversarial and insufficient-evidence cases, and compare prompt revisions under the same model and data settings.
